purpose: A bounded procedure for reviewing and correcting a confirmed UI visual defect.

preconditions: A bounded UI task packet exists.
An expected visual target or behavior can be stated.
excluded_cases: Subjective redesign without an approved target.
Production UI changes without separate authorization.

phases.objective: Establish the expected visual target and behavior.
Inspect the authoritative UI implementation and reproduce the defect.
required_verification: defect is observed at a supported viewport where applicable

phases.objective: Apply only the approved bounded correction.
Perform required viewport or visual verification and applicable regression checks.
Report the bounded outcome and stop.

required_verification: required viewport or visual verification where applicable
allowed_capabilities: capture bounded visual evidence when supported
human_gates: approval of the exact task and resolved procedure before mutation
failure_handling: record BLOCKED_PRECONDITION, FAILED_AFTER_EXECUTION, or DIVERGENCE as applicable
do not require unsupported visual tooling
